statements.impact_statement: u-root v0.16.0 includes the archive fixes from upstream PR2344; Go advisory GO-2022-0805 marks versions before v0.9.0 affected. Scout incorrectly compares against 7.0.0. https://github.com/u-root/u-root/pull/2344 https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2022-0805

u-root v0.16.0 includes the archive fixes from upstream PR2344; Go advisory GO-2022-0793 marks versions before v0.9.0 affected. https://github.com/u-root/u-root/pull/2344 https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2022-0793

Official Linux amd64 cloudflared 2026.10.7 (SHA256 pinned in Dockerfile). This advisory affects Windows before 2020.8.1. The Go pseudoversion is incorrectly compared to a calendar release version. https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/security/advisories/GHSA-hgwp-4vp4-qmm2

PhValheim sets Acquire::Retries to 0 before the first APT build operation and retains that configuration in the delivered image. Ubuntu states exploitation requires a non-zero Acquire::Retries setting. buildRcDetached.sh checks the effective value inside the built image before publishing or applying this assessment. This is a configuration mitigation, not a patched APT package; overriding the setting invalidates this assessment. https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-109518

For the three SHA256-pinned Linux amd64 binaries listed in remote-access-binaries.sha256 only. Go advisory GO-2026-6860 affects golang.org/x/net/html parsing. govulncheck v1.9.0 binary scans report module metadata only, with no affected html package or symbols in tailscale, tailscaled or cloudflared. A v0.61.0 html.Parse positive-control binary reports the affected package and Parse/ParseWithOptions symbols. Build verification requires all three exact binary checksums before applying this assessment. Evidence: remote-access-html-scan.json; https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6860
